title: Visitors enter a windowed office
global_prompt: Four five-second shots follow the entrance, the suited man's change of posture, an exchange across the desk, and the visitors' reactions as the woman leaves.

observed_facts.text: Closed gray paneled double doors give way to an open doorway; the dark-jacket visitor enters first, with the beige-jacket visitor behind him and a partially occluded blonde woman farther back.

The two men advance into the room toward screen left, the shorter dark-jacket visitor remaining ahead. His striped gray shirt and hanging badge and the taller visitor's beige jacket and glasses are visible.
The framing follows the men leftward, revealing pale paneled office walls, framed art and furniture while the warm doorway shifts toward the right edge.

shots.observed_camera: Initially faces the doors, then follows the entering men in a medium view. The changing background supports leftward following movement; precise pan versus lateral travel is unresolved. No sampled internal cut is apparent.
shots.action_temporality: Frames 0–1 establish closed-to-open doors; frames 1–4 show the visitors progressing into the office.
uncertainties: The exact hand contact opening the doors is not visible.
shots.generation_prompt_en: Over five seconds, gray paneled double doors open onto a warmly lit hallway. The Dark-jacket visitor, a short dark-haired man in a black leather jacket over a dark hooded layer and striped gray shirt, with a gold-colored badge on a neck chain, walks into the pale paneled office. The taller Beige-jacket visitor follows, wearing thin metal-framed glasses, a beige jacket and a pale collared shirt. The Doorway woman, blonde with pinned-up hair and a dark sleeveless dress, is briefly visible behind them. Follow the men leftward in a medium view as they enter, keeping the Dark-jacket visitor in front and revealing framed art along the office wall.

adaptations.text: Extend the entrance from approximately 3.21 seconds to five seconds with a slower walking pace.

observed_facts.text: The suited man reclines in a black office chair with both black-shod feet on the wooden desk, holding a small phone beside his face. He wears a dark suit, pink striped shirt, red tie and matching pocket square.
He draws his feet off the desk, brings his hands and phone inward, sits forward and begins rising from the chair.

An open black laptop, dark writing mat and loose papers occupy the desk. Large gridded windows overlook neighboring buildings; a metal drinks stand with a shaker and lidded bucket stands to the right.

shots.observed_camera: Medium-wide frontal desk view with a slight upward framing adjustment as the man rises. Background structures remain consistent across the samples; no internal cut is apparent.
shots.action_temporality: Feet are on the desk in frame 0, move away in frame 1 and are below the desktop by frame 2. Frames 3–4 show his forward movement into a rise.
uncertainties: The final phone placement and completion of standing are not shown in this shot.
shots.generation_prompt_en: In the daylight office, the Suited man has wavy brown hair and wears a dark suit, a pale pink striped shirt, a red tie and matching pocket square. Reclining in a black chair behind the Wooden office desk, he initially has both black shoes on the desktop and the Small handheld phone beside his face. Across five seconds he lowers his feet, brings the phone down between his hands and leans forward to begin standing. Keep the Open black laptop on the dark writing mat, with loose papers nearby. Behind him, tall gridded windows reveal city buildings, and a metal drinks stand holds a shaker and lidded bucket.

adaptations.text: Slow the approximately 1.75-second posture change to five seconds, ending during the rise without specifying the phone's destination.

observed_facts.text: The visitors face the desk from its near side. The dark-jacket visitor is central with his back increasingly toward the camera, while the beige-jacket visitor stands to the right. A leftward widening of the view reveals the suited man standing behind the desk.
The suited man holds a hand near his chest, then extends a pointing hand toward the visitors and returns his hands toward the front of his jacket.
At the end, the dark-jacket visitor extends his right arm toward screen right. The desk and laptop remain between the men, beside the same window grid and metal drinks stand.

The beige-jacket visitor glances toward his companion, faces forward, and finally turns toward the doorway; the dark-jacket visitor also turns his head left in the final sample.

The stocky man has blue eyes, heavy eyebrows, a curled fair mustache, a brown flat cap and a tan coat over dark blue knitwear. Hold a close view over the mime's right-foreground shoulder, showing his swept brown hair, white-painted facial edge and striped collar above a dark jacket. The stocky man subtly shifts his head and brows, opens his mouth, then closes it while keeping his attention on the mime.

adaptations.text: Extend the sampled facial exchange to five seconds using gentle pacing and a brief closing hold.

observed_facts.text: In a sepia-toned street view, the unpainted pompadoured man faces the bob-haired female mime, whose profile and raised pale hand occupy the right foreground; plaster facades and wooden storefronts stand behind them.
The man's hand moves from below the visible interaction to clasp the female mime's raised gloved hand, holding it upright between them.
He initially has lowered brows and exposed teeth, briefly widens his eyes while holding her hand, then returns to a furrowed expression.

Her near-right profile shows a brown bob, beret and white makeup above a striped high neck. Across five seconds, she holds up a pale gloved hand; he reaches up and clasps it upright between them. His tense, teeth-baring expression briefly becomes wide-eyed before his brows draw together again. Keep their joined hands visible.

adaptations.text: Slow the visible reach, clasp, and facial changes to occupy five seconds; interpolate only a simple reach between sampled poses.

observed_facts.text: The reverse view shows the female mime beside a carved wooden doorway and dark glazed panels, facing the man's blurred head and blazer shoulder at left.
She begins with both hands together near her mouth and raised inner brows, then separates them, placing one against her chest and extending the other toward the man.
She lowers her hands, tilts her head and smiles, then extends both open palms toward screen right while looking back toward the man.

shots.action_temporality: Five ordered samples support the progression from clasped hands to chest gesture to smiling outward presentation.

observed_facts.text: Fuller color returns. The male mime faces the stocky man's large tan-coated shoulder at left, with the curved-glass storefront, a green shopfront and pastel facades behind.

His expression brightens and he turns slightly, extending both open gloved palms toward screen right while looking toward the stocky man.

title: Office presentation and alternating close-ups
global_prompt: Four five-second shots preserve the presentation gesture, the woman's subtle reaction, the man's changing head orientation, and the return to the woman's restrained smile.

observed_facts.text: The man in a dark button-front shirt stands beside the black framed photograph on a silver easel, with the photograph to screen left.

Across the samples, his right hand gestures low across the photograph's front while his left hand changes position near his torso; by the last sample his right hand is lowered beside the display. His gaze shifts from the display toward screen right.

The office has glass partitions, windows with blinds, cool daylight and a red rectangular artwork. A white tabletop at lower right holds several rounded bottles with red caps and visible POM branding.
All five samples retain the same medium-wide office view and display arrangement; no internal edited view is apparent.

uncertainties: Whether his right hand touches the photograph or only passes in front of it is unclear.

The large black frame has a broad white mat and shows a person using a camera near stocked shelves. Over five seconds, he makes a relaxed low gesture with his right hand in front of the photograph while his left hand gestures near his torso, then lowers his right hand and looks toward screen right. Cool window light filters through blinds and glass partitions; red-capped rounded beverage bottles occupy the edge of a white table at lower right. Omit the source watermark.

A pale wall and white sign with the website text 'www.pomwonderful.com' are behind her. A lower-third reading 'Lynda Resnick / Owner/CEO / POM Wonderful' appears in frames 1–3 and is absent in frames 0 and 4.
The five samples consistently show this woman's close-up; the changing lower-third overlays the same live view rather than replacing it with a title insert.
